mcp.name: instadomain
mcp.description: AI agents buy domains autonomously via x402 (USDC on Base), no human in the loop. Also supports Stripe checkout for manual approval. Includes Cloudflare DNS, WHOIS privacy, transfers, and renewals.

tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Check if a domain is available and get its price. Always call before purchasing.

tools.name: check_domains_bulk
tools.description: Check availability of up to 50 domains in one call via RDAP.

tools.name: suggest_domains
tools.description: Generate domain name ideas from a keyword and check availability across .com, .io, .ai, .dev, .co.

tools.name: buy_domain_crypto
tools.description: Autonomous purchase via x402 protocol. Agent pays with USDC on Base, no human needed. Returns a pay_url for the x402 HTTP client.

tools.name: buy_domain
tools.description: Manual purchase via Stripe checkout. Returns a checkout URL for the user to approve.

tools.name: get_domain_status
tools.description: Poll order status until registration completes. Returns nameservers and Cloudflare DNS API token.

tools.name: get_transfer_code
tools.description: Get EPP auth code for transferring a domain to another registrar.

tools.name: unlock_domain
tools.description: Unlock a domain for transfer to another registrar.

tools.name: renew_domain
tools.description: Renew domain registration via Stripe checkout.

payment_methods: x402 (USDC on Base) - autonomous agent payment
